items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And my Nara Ucha take a steamboat? Do you remember that?

ctx.x: Is that the one Where's the Waiter with the water for Madonna and all that stuff? Yeah, yeah, yeah. Now I remember. It comes back.
